mod.name: Probably Automated
mod.note: The first two printer nights used 0.2.6. Reload, final printer output and all other production scenarios used 0.2.7. This is not an immutable-build replay of every night.

method: Official C# MCP client -> stdio server -> authenticated local bridge -> native Unity actions. Normal open/close/sleep settlement only; no developer mode, day skipping, or edited game/save values.

saveProtection.note: All 17 pre-existing save_*.es3 files, including the user saves and previous test slots, have unchanged SHA-256 hashes. Save index/global metadata may change normally. Last daytime retrieval/processing is not claimed to persist across reload without another autosave.
